couldntLoadOpen: Couldn't load. Open to try again.
rowPhotosSub: Your photo, the shop front and the salon video
rowOffersSub: Discounts customers see on your services
rowRatingsSub: What customers said after their visit
rulesSummary: {notice} min notice · up to {days} days ahead
ownerOnlyChange: Only the owner can change these.
infoIntro: What customers see for {name}. Only the owner can change it.
noOffers: No offers on now or coming.
noticeHint: Customers can't book a time closer than this. 0 lets them book for right now.
noBarbersBody: Add everyone who cuts hair, yourself too if you do.
hoursChanged: Someone changed the hours meanwhile. The page now shows the latest; check and save again.
hoursHint: Switch off your weekly off day. Barbers' hours must fit inside these.
barbersOutside: Some barbers work outside these hours
cutAndSave: Cut their hours to fit and save
hoursNotSetByOwner: The owner hasn't set the opening hours yet.
closedDaysBefore: For festival holidays and other days the whole salon is closed, use
openAtLeastOne: Open at least one day a week.
svcNameLetters: A name with at least 2 letters or digits
svcMinutesError: From 5 to 480 minutes, in steps of 5
svcPriceError: A price in rupees, up to ₹1,00,000
picturesNote: The service pictures are new: each service comes with the one that shows it. Tap a service to see or change it.
noServicesBody: Add what you offer, like Haircut ₹200 for 30 minutes.
offServicesNote: Switched-off services can't be booked; old bookings keep their names.
priceFrom: Price can go up at the salon (shown as "from ₹…")
returnLabel: Remind customers to come back after (days)
returnHint: 0 = no reminder. Customers who booked it get one push message, e.g. 21 days after a haircut.
noPictureMatch: No picture matches this name, so it gets the general one (a salon chair).
barberGone: This barber isn't here any more
barberChanged: Someone changed this barber meanwhile. The page now shows the latest; try again.
bookingsInTheWayHint: Give these to another barber or cancel them on the day board, then save again.
removeHint: For a barber who won't come back. To pause one who comes and goes (a contract barber), switch off "Working here" instead: his services and hours are kept for when he returns.
removeConfirm: Remove {name} for good? His past bookings keep his name.
workingHereHint: Switched off, he can't be booked. His bookings must be moved first.
photoHint: Customers may see it when choosing a barber.
ownProfileHint: This is you, signed in as the owner. If you stop cutting hair, switch this profile off, or remove it.
signInHint: With a sign-in he opens this app with his phone number and sees his own bookings. You invite his number; he accepts in Clozest.
invitedWaiting: Invited: +91 {phone}, waiting for him to accept
signInRemoved: Sign-in removed. He is signed out.
invitationSent: Invitation sent. He'll see it in Clozest when he signs in with this number.
dayEndAfterStart: {day}: the end must be after the start.
fitInside: They must fit inside the salon's opening hours.
